messages:
incident-bot: PAGE • prod-inference: GPU queue size rising > 2k, autoscaler failing to provision GPU nodes (alert id: alert-9832). Affected routes: /v1/embeddings, /v1/generate. See runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/gpu-autoscale

Priya N: acked — I'm oncall for infra. Paging SRE and ML infra. Will gather logs and impact metrics.

Alex W: oncall-ml here, looking. Quick ask: are we seeing IAM errors in the autoscaler logs or attach failures?

Priya N: copying the autoscaler controller log snippet we pulled from /var/log/aws-autoscaler.log:```
2026-03-15T02:05:12Z ERROR attach_nodegroup: failed to create nodegroup: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodNodeInstanceRole
	status code: 403, request id: b9f1-...
```

Josh T: that matches the earlier pager from deploy last night where a new launch-template version rolled out without the right instance-profile binding. If autoscaler can't create nodes it will backlog.

Priya N: kubectl output for pending pods (from inference namespace):```
$ kubectl get pods -n inference --field-selector=status.phase==Pending
NAME                                READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
embedder-5c9d7-xx                  0/1     Pending   0          14m
generator-7f9b2-yy                 0/1     Pending   0          12m

$ kubectl describe pod embedder-5c9d7-xx
Events:
  Type     Reason            Age   From               Message
  ----     ------            ----  ----               -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling  2m    default-scheduler  0/12 nodes are available: 12 node(s) didn't match taint, 12 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu
```

Sara L: impact check — dashboards show 5xx rate on embeddings up from 0.6% to 12% in last 15m, and 95th token latency for /generate is 2.4s -> 6.1s. External customers: two enterprise accounts reported degraded throughput to support.

Priya N: immediate mitigation plan: 1) stop autoscaler creating new nodegroups until we confirm fix; 2) manually create a temporary nodegroup with a validated instance-profile; 3) route non-critical/low-cost traffic to CPU fallback model; 4) rollback launch-template to previous working version. Doing 1 & 2 now.

Alex W: agree. For manual nodegroup create use the existing role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodNodeInstanceRole-v2 (the v2 role has proper PassRole). I can kick terraform in a minute.

Priya N: pausing autoscaler (scaledown disabled) via controller API:```
curl -X POST 'https://infra-api.redwood.internal/autoscaler/controls/pause' -d '{"cluster":"prod-inference","reason":"incident-2287654321"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```
Response: {"status":"paused"}

Josh T: routing change in progress — switching ~30% of free-tier traffic to redwood-small-quant for embeddings to reduce GPU pressure. Using console -> traffic-split.

ops-bot: INFO: terraform apply started for manual nodegroup creation (apply id: tf-3392).

Alex W: terraform output error initially:```
Error: UnauthorizedOperation: iam:PassRole is not allowed for role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodNodeInstanceRole
status code: 403
```
I'm switching to the known-good role (RedwoodNodeInstanceRole-v2) and reapplying.

Priya N: manual aws cli create-nodegroup attempt (after role swap) succeeded, launching 4 p4d-type instances (temp pool). kubelet joining..

ops-bot: INFO: nodes registered: gpu-node-pt1 (Ready), gpu-node-pt2 (Ready), gpu-node-pt3 (Ready), gpu-node-pt4 (Ready)

Priya N: pods are starting to schedule. Metrics trending back: queue length halving in 8m.

Sara L: communicate to customers — sending status update to affected enterprise customers with ETA ~30m for full recovery. I'll post on status.redwood.ai once queue normalizes.

Alex W: postmortem action items (short): 1) fix IAM drift that allowed new launch-template to reference role without PassRole; 2) add autoscaler pre-check to validate instance profile permissions before creating nodegroups; 3) pin launch-template versions for autoscaler; 4) add runbook step for routing fallback.

Mike K: taking handoff for night shift. Current state: autoscaler paused, temp nodegroup up, routing split at 30% CPU fallback, observed 5xx down to 1.8% and p95 down to 3.0s. I'll watch for 1h and then unpause autoscaler after we verify IAM fix.

Priya N: handing off to @Mike K. Remaining immediate tasks for Mike: 1) confirm rollback of LT v3 -> v2; 2) open infra-ticket to whitelist iam:PassRole on the role used by new LT; 3) confirm taint controller didn't misapply GPU taints across nodes.

Josh T: created ticket INFRA-1145: "Autoscaler should validate instance-profile PassRole before nodegroup create" and assigned to Alex. Link: https://redwood.internal/INFRA-1145

Priya N: quick note about taints — we saw pods complaining about taints earlier but that was symptom: nodes made with wrong instance-profile didn't come up, so pods stayed pending; when nodes arrived they have taint nvidia-gpu=true:NoSchedule which is expected. We'll verify GPU driver + node labels.

ops-bot: INFO: rollback of launch-template to version v2 completed (deploy id: lt-rollback-2287654321).

Sara L: aiming for incident summary in 2 hours. For now: impact subset = embeddings/generation requests on prod; ~12% 5xx peak; manual mitigation reduced to ~1.8% and service recovering. No data exfiltration, no security breach.

Mike K: acknowledged handoff. I'll post updates to this thread every 15m. If anything spikes, page me directly or escalate to Sara.

Priya N: thanks team — nice run. Logging notes into the runbook and will include exact CLI snippets and aws logs in the postmortem.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE • incident-2287654321 • status: Mitigated -> monitoring. Timeline and artifacts: https://redwood.incidents/2287654321
